title: MULTI-seq
scope: McGinnis 2019 MULTI-seq sample-indexing implementation represented by the MULTI-Seq row: LMO-mediated indexing of separate cell treatment groups, intact-cell pooling and a common scRNA-seq interface yielding distinct synthetic sample-index and transcript-derived expression libraries. The mRNA vignette identifies the biological expression target. The three dishes are independently routed schematic groups, not assignments of the paper’s particular cell types or treatments. The neighboring SNRS and Hi-SCL rows, CMO implementations and single-nucleus applications are outside this assigned depiction. The broad scRNA-seq block is expanded only enough to explain its consequential library products and information linkage.
